decision_cruda.rationale: LH-04 is down at E543-01 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 11:30, and the range is 11:00–12:00. The closest cheap lender, LH-08 (dev 1.0 oz/h), needs 0.77 h to get there and would arrive at 10:46. Lunch runs 11:00–11:30, so it would load only about 0.25 h before the likely repair. That is roughly 1 oz of ore (23.6 t/h at 5.8 g/t), against about 1.5–2 oz of lost development value. LH-09 is worse at 1.5 oz/h. The stope has 260 t, and the repaired LH-04 can still load most of it by 17:00. No stope is stopped, so no reserve can be activated. LH-10 is in preventive maintenance until 12:00. No loans.
